name: The Test of Righteousness
summary: Jordan Stilwell has a sacred weapon in mind for a paladin worthy of the Light. The Ironforge smith needs rare materials from distant lands, including his lost family hammer.

sections.title: A Sacred Commission
sections.body: Outside Ironforge's gates, Jordan Stilwell cannot forge the paladin's weapon on his own. You gather the materials his craft demands.

sections.title: Components of Consecration
sections.body: Jordan Stilwell needs four things for the weapon: Whitestone Oak lumber, refined ore from master prospectors, a purified Kor Gem, and his smithing hammer. He left the hammer behind while escaping Shadowfang Keep. Finding all four means facing dangers across the Eastern Kingdoms and beyond.

sections.title: The Smith's Heritage
sections.body: Jordan Stilwell needs his father's hammer for the work. The heirloom is bound to his craft and family line. With the hammer recovered and a rare Kor Gem purified, Jordan can pursue plans he has carried for years and forge an instrument of justice.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: Jordan Stilwell needs rare materials from across the realm to forge a holy weapon for rising paladins. Gathering them tests their devotion and sacrifice.

aliases: who is the smith outside ironforge
faq.answer: Jordan Stilwell is a human weaponsmith outside Ironforge's gates in Dun Morogh. He plans a sacred weapon for paladins and seeks his father's lost smithing hammer.

faq.q: What materials are needed to forge the weapon?
faq.answer: Jordan needs Jordan's Smithing Hammer, Whitestone Oak Lumber, Bailor's Refined Ore Shipment, and a Purified Kor Gem.

faq.q: Why is Jordan's hammer so important to him?
faq.answer: Jordan's hammer belonged to his father. Recovering this family heirloom returns it to Jordan's forge and gives him a tool tied to his craft and lineage.
A Kor Gem is a rare, potent stone. Purified of corrupting influences, it can focus the power used to consecrate a holy weapon.

faq.q: Where does Jordan Stilwell craft this weapon?
aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: Jordan Stilwell works just outside Ironforge's snowy gates in the mountains of Dun Morogh.

angles.text: As a paladin, you face a trial of devotion and sacrifice for a weapon forged to channel the Light.
As a blacksmith, you see Jordan Stilwell unite a reclaimed heirloom tool with purified arcane and mineral components to craft a holy relic.
As a member of the Alliance, you rely on human craftsmanship and Alliance holdings across Khaz Modan and beyond to arm defenders against rising dark threats.
